scripts.build: rimraf dist && npm run build --workspace @cally/server && npm run build --workspace @cally/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @cally/client" "npm run dev --workspace @cally/server"
scripts.prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node --env-file=.env ./dist/index.mjs
